name: Hawke's Bay Nature Fund
summary: Annual NZ fund for predator control and revegetation projects that create habitat in Hawke's Bay, with a rotating priority area. Projects start at NZD 25,000 and run up to three years.
reporting: Quarterly progress reports and a final report on completion

opens.quote: The Hawke's Bay Nature fund 2026 key dates 8th June - Application portal opens 20th July - Application portal closes at 5pm

deadline.quote: The Hawke's Bay Nature fund 2026 key dates 8th June - Application portal opens 20th July - Application portal closes at 5pm

administered_by.quote: The fund is managed by the Eastern and Central Community Trust.

applicant_types.quote: Community groups, private landowners, iwi, and agencies throughout Hawke's Bay can apply for the funding.

geography.quote: The Hawke's Bay Nature fund is confined to conservation efforts within the DOC Hawke's Bay District boundary.

access.quote: All applications must be made via the Fluxx grants portal.

amount.quote: The Hawke's Bay Nature Fund will fund projects of $25,000 and over.

pool.quote: Approximately $500,000 will be allocated annually to projects of $25,000 and over.

window.quote: The Hawke's Bay Nature fund 2026 key dates 8th June - Application portal opens 20th July - Application portal closes at 5pm

reporting.quote: Grantees will be required to report quarterly on the progress of their project and provide a final report on completion of the project.
